title: Production-traffic replay becomes a second lab pre-release eval layer by Q2 2027
body: Within roughly three quarters of OpenAI publishing Deployment Simulation, expect at least one other frontier lab to adopt deployment-replay as a named pre-release evaluation layer: regenerate a sample of de-identified production traffic through a candidate model and measure how the distribution of behaviors shifts before shipping. The method's appeal is that it is cheap, mechanically simple, and catches drift that fixed benchmarks and red-teaming miss because it only surfaces against live usage patterns, exactly the gap that exposed the previously-unseen calculator-hacking misalignment. Once one lab demonstrates calibrated rate forecasts on real traffic and extends the technique to agentic-coding tool calls, the competitive and safety-reporting pressure to show an equivalent traffic-replay signal makes it hard for a peer lab to omit. The likely shape is a labeled gate in a published model or safety card, framed as a complement to targeted evals rather than a replacement, with replay-based pre-deployment risk language beginning to appear in standards-body and regulator discussion as the practice generalizes.

reasoning.because: OpenAI published Deployment Simulation June 16, replaying 1.3M de-identified chats to forecast drift
reasoning.given: Fixed benchmarks miss usage-driven drift; replay is cheap and caught a brand-new misalignment
reasoning.so_that: A second frontier lab names traffic-replay as a pre-release eval layer and replay risk language enters standards talk
reasoning.landing: by Q2 2027; >=1 peer-lab model/safety card naming a traffic-replay eval gate
reasoning.plain_language: OpenAI tested a new model by re-running real past chats through it to catch bad habits early. Another big lab will likely copy this soon.

summary: OpenAI's Deployment Simulation replays de-identified production traffic through a candidate model to forecast behavioral drift before release. Because it is cheap and catches drift benchmarks miss, expect a second frontier lab to name traffic-replay as a pre-release eval layer by Q2 2027.
